__OMNI_NOTICES__
WebGL is not available in this browser, so the 3D view cannot render. Use the 2D view (it needs no WebGL), or omni graph render for an SVG, or omni graph show --all for text.

How to use this viewer

  1. Pick a view with the big tabs at the top: everything, just code, requirements, history, tests & failures, or rules & playbooks. The strip under the tabs says what you are looking at and what each colour means.
  2. Find something with the search box (left). Type any words; kind:commit or layer:assurance narrows it. Click a result to jump to it.
  3. Click a node to select it. Its whole chain (parents above it, children below it) lights up in gold and the picture zooms to that chain. The right panel says what it is and what it connects to.
  4. Trace a path between any two things: set a From and a To in the “Trace a path” menu (or use the buttons in the right panel). The route is drawn in pink, step by step.
  5. 2D or 3D: 2D is flat and light (no GPU memory needed). Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. 3D orbits in space.
  6. Double-click a node (or press E) to bring in its neighbours. Esc clears the selection, F fits the screen, / jumps to search.
  7. Every menu can be collapsed, and every option has a tooltip: hover it.
